```
{python}
from dolfin import *
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D
import matplotlib.tri as tri

# --- Mesh and function ---
mesh = UnitSquareMesh(5,5)
V = FunctionSpace(mesh, "Lagrange", 1)

i = 14
phi = Function(V)
phi.vector()[:] = 0.0
phi.vector()[i] = 1.0

# --- Triangulation for plotting ---
coords = mesh.coordinates()
cells = mesh.cells()
triang = tri.Triangulation(coords[:,0], coords[:,1], triangles=cells)

# --- Values at nodes ---
z = phi.vector().get_local()

# --- 3D plot ---
fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d')
ax.plot_trisurf(triang, z, cmap='viridis', edgecolor='k')
ax.set_xlabel('x')
ax.set_ylabel('y')
ax.set_zlabel('phi')
plt.show()
```

```{r}
# Parameters
a <- 25
b <- 25
kappa <- 4
alpha <- 1.8
m = 4
beta <- alpha/2

nx <- 25
ny <- 25
T_final <- 0.1
time_step <- 0.001
time_seq <- seq(0, T_final, length.out = ((T_final - 0) / time_step + 1))
coeff <- 1
which_eig <- 2
```


```{r}
FEM_matrices <- fem$fem_shifted_laplacian_sparse(
  a = a,
  b = b, 
  nx = nx, 
  ny = ny
  )

C <- FEM_matrices$C
G <- FEM_matrices$G
L <- kappa^2*C + G

x <- FEM_matrices$x
y <- FEM_matrices$y

true_eig <- compute_true_eigen_rectangle(
  a = a, 
  b = b, 
  x = x, 
  y = y, 
  kappa = kappa,
  m_max = 5, 
  n_max = 5
  )

eigvals <- true_eig$eigvals
eigfuncs <- true_eig$eigfuncs
```



```{r}
plot_3d_slider(x, y, eigvals, eigfuncs)
```

```{r}
U_0 <- coeff * eigfuncs[[which_eig]]
U_true <- lapply(exp(-(eigvals[which_eig]^(alpha/2)) * time_seq), function(xi) U_0 * xi)
```


```{r}
plot_3d_slider(x, y, time_seq, U_true)
```


```{r}
my_op_frac <- my.fractional.operators.frac(L, beta, C, scale.factor = kappa^2, m = m, time_step)


U_aux <- solve_fractional_evolution(my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, val_at_0 = as.vector(U_0))

U_approx <- lapply(1:ncol(U_aux), function(j) matrix(U_aux[, j], nrow = length(x), ncol = length(y), byrow = FALSE))
```



```{r}
plot_3d_slider(x, y, time_seq, U_approx)
```

```{r}
diff <- Map(function(a, b) abs(a - b), U_true, U_approx)
error_at_each_time <- sapply(diff, function(M) sum(M^2))
plot_3d_slider(x, y, error_at_each_time, diff)
```
